title: Let service stay hidden and real
summary: Service becomes true when the self stops asking to be seen. Let hidden service leave the self unseen, quieter, and true.
takeaway: Let hidden service leave the self unseen, quieter, and true.
lifeApplication: Do one needed thing today with your own hands and leave it there, without carrying it back into self-advertisement.

source.shortMeaning: Service becomes true when the self stops asking to be seen.
source.lifeApplication: Do one needed thing today without asking to be seen for it.
